categories.evidence: 42 MJCF files compile, source geometry/inertia available; earlier random terrain height/query tests pass. This does not certify collision normals.
Static support balances 188.85 N; base ~50%, edges ~25% each when flat.
5/10/20 N cantilever loads within 0.64% of configured small-angle discrete stiffness; unload residual <1e-9 rad. Real EI not calibrated.
At 35deg loaded edge carries support; 100N transverse force held, 150N slips; pure pitch does not activate edging.
Slow controlled transfer has small energy residual after recorded actuator work, but ~262N one-step force changes; high-speed transfer unvalidated.
Flat heightfield normal errors reach 89.96deg and speed differs 7.31% from plane; finer grid does not converge.
35deg roll, 4m/s initial speed, zero yaw drive: speed differs 26.51% after ~1s between 1ms and 0.5ms; trajectories diverge.
Assembly contype=4/conaffinity=3 blocks robot-robot pairs; no explicit pairs restore them.
First-contact 80ms impulse window converges across 1/0.5/0.25ms, but this is flat, orientation-clamped, non-robot landing.
Mogul probes retain centimetre penetration after payload-inertia correction; jump trajectories remain step-sensitive. No full G1 course closure.
CPU stepping and terrain query adapters exist; reset/observation/action/phase/reward/termination schema and batch backend integration are not completed.
